content:
Jon Stewart went in on Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and his macho man vision for the U.S. military in comments that dropped less than 24 hours after a failed House impeachment push against the ex-Fox News host.

“Go fuck yourself!” said Stewart of Hegseth’s “fucking insecure,” transphobic ideology for the military on Wednesday’s episode of “The Weekly Show.”

Stewart — when asked if Hegseth scares people more because he’s “so macho” or because he’s “such a moron” — mockingly pointed to the former before taking on the defense secretary’s anti-woke doctrine.

“It’s such a narrow, cartoonish, caricatured vision of what it means to have a force that’s effective and, by the way, utilized properly,” he said.

“It’s not just about the strength of it; it’s about not getting us into reckless situations that people could see forming from a mile away that would constrict our ability to get fuel for the next year.”

As for the efforts to impeach Hegseth, Stewart said the ex-Fox News host “sucks so badly” that Donald Trump should save him the trouble and — as he often did on “The Apprentice” — tell him he’s fired.

Hegseth — who is polling worse than the president and two ex-Cabinet members — is pushing for a $1.5 trillion defense budget, or an over 40% increase in military spending.

“So the idea that impeachment is the only recourse for any of this — he should be fired for fucking sucking,” Stewart said.

“He shouldn’t be impeached; we should live in a system where the people that run our institutions are accountable enough that obvious, lousy performance has consequences to their employment.”
